Directorate of Health Safety & Regulation
- Himachal Pradesh

In pursuance to the letter No. PER(AP)C-B(2)-1/2019 dated
28/12/2021 issued by the Department of Personnel and on the recommendations of the
Screening Committee of the Directorate of Health Safety & Regulation, H.P., the competent
authority is pleased to order regularisation of services of the following Food Safety Officers
in the Department of Health Safety & Regulation, in the pay band of Rs. 5910-20200 + 3000
G.P. with immediate effect in public interest:-

Sr. | Name of Food Safety Officer Present Place of Posting
No.
" 1. Sh. Sachin Lakhanpal CMO Office Mandi
a Sh.Abhishek Thakur CMO Office Kinnaur
3. | Sh. Anuj Sharma CMO Office Solan
4. | Ms. Varsha CMO Office Mandi
5. Sh. Kheem Singh CMO Office Kullu
6. | Ms. Priyanka Kashyap CMO Office Una
7 Smt. Sugandhi Kaundal CMO Office Kangra
8. Ms. Madhu Bala CMO Office Hamirpur
9, Smt. Priya Negi CMO Office Shimla

The terms and conditions of regularisation are as under :-
Terms and Conditions:-

(1) That on Regularisation, the officers shall be appointed on the minimum of the pay
scale i.e. Rs. 5910-20200 + 3000 and they will be entitled to get the revised pay scale
of Rs. 10300-34800 + 4200 after completion of 2 years of regular service.

(2) These Food Safety officers will be entitled to draw dearness and other allowances at
the rate admissible and subject to the conditions laid down in the rules and
orders/instructions in force issued by the State Government from time to time.

&/ (3) The Regularisation shall carry with it the liability to serve in any part of Himachal
Pradesh. .

(4) The Regularisation will be on probation for a period of 2 years and during the period
of probation his/her service can be terminated at any time by giving one month’s
notice or pay in lieu thereof by the appointing authority without assigning any
reason. .

(5) The regularisation is subject to the Character and antecedents of the candidates being
found satisfactory on verification.
